lanes.summary: Diff implements all three tickets with no refuting defect found. GH-4351: lean_has_sorry replaces the naive substring scan with a comment/string/char-literal-aware tokenizer, fails closed on unterminated comments/strings, adds the Theorems.<Domain>.<File> citation form, and is backed by an exhaustive must_match/must_not_match case table plus a real-fixture regression test; both referenced Lean fixtures exist on disk and match the test's stated premises. PMAT-4380: 10+ build.rs producers were migrated from the gone ../../../provable-contracts sibling to in-tree contracts/<crate>/binding.yaml, with a hard panic when contracts/ exists but the per-crate binding.yaml is missing (monorepo-only; crates.io fallback via CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=none preserved). The #[contract] macro was hardened (#4368/#2699): option_env! replaces env!, a registry_miss compile_error! fires only when a producer's CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=binding.yaml sentinel is set and the site has no row, and previously-silently-dropped malformed conditions now fail closed as compile errors — all covered by case-table unit tests. Two genuinely-inert build.rs stubs (aprender-graph, aprender-verify, which only printed a cargo:warning and never emitted CONTRACT_* vars) were deleted rather than upgraded, which does not regress any real enforcement. Three aprender-serve #[contract] sites were renamed (gemm-v1/forward-pass-v1/sampling-v1 -> matmul-kernel-v1/rmsnorm-kernel-v1/softmax-kernel-v1) and verified to match rows with status: implemented in the restored contracts/realizar/binding.yaml. PMAT-4581: the sha2 opt-level=3 Cargo.toml profile override is scoped and documented; cbtop M001-M003/M007/M008/M010 tests moved to crates/apr-cli/tests/falsification_cbtop_measurement.rs using CARGO_BIN_EXE_apr (no cargo-run-per-test, no SKIP-on-absent-binary since the binary is now a build input); the old include file's residual tests (M004-M006, M009, M011) still assert correctly. verify-ml book oracle tests skip cleanly with a stderr reason when python3 is absent but still assert (not vacuously) when present. The "dead ALLOWED_GAPS pruned" criterion, not visible as changed lines in this diff, was independently verified by reading the current crates/aprender-core/build.rs: ALLOWED_GAPS contains only the 3 not-yet-implemented ssm-kernel-v1 entries. No test asserts the opposite of a ticket, no gate is weakened (several are meaningfully strengthened), and no out-of-scope changes were found.
